methodology.purpose: diagnostic only; production weights are unchanged and fixed-weight missing-data handling is reconstructed explicitly
methodology.source: full stocks.json score_dimensions, so each specialist model is tested with its real production weight pack
methodology.missing_weight_handling: production keeps nominal weights fixed; missing dimensions contribute neutral percentile 50 while evidence coverage remains separate
methodology.structural_unavailability: flag dimensions with positive nominal weight but zero observed coverage across the entire score model; do not silently treat them as ordinary row-level missingness
methodology.sector_bias_note: descriptive concentration only; not causal evidence
methodology.reconstruction_parity: reconstruct score_dimensions, apply structural score_cap, compare with score_raw; public score moderation by evidence confidence is reported separately

known_methodological_issue_to_test: Specialist packs now use same-model peer benchmarks when a metric has at least 20 finite observations, with a global fallback for sparse metrics. The remaining benchmark-scope question is whether the 20-observation fallback threshold and model taxonomy remain stable out of sample.
next_step: Combine cross-sectional stability with prospective 4/12/24-week rank IC and top-minus-bottom return spreads before changing production weights or normalization universes.
